bars.says: A visiting crew on the flat polluted metal plateau beneath the fixed desert sun can follow deliberate corridors to salvage and machine-held ground, choose an open route or a visibly marked trespassing cut, and recognise stationary pools that harm entrants before stepping in.

meant.intent: Reject if the selected maze is just random scrap or offers no understandable route choice; it is the place the player came to enter. Reject harmless sulfuric decoration or invisible exposure at the pools: the owner set that land cost alongside garrisons and sacrilege.
meant.source: Owner-selected experience in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md; frozen sheet §1/§5; owner answers 2026-11-10 in designer_codex_2026-11-09/RustCathedral/ANSWERS_OWNER.md; delegated route contract from these. Pool cost: owner ruling 2026-08-19 in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/the_forgotten_war.md:232; sheet §6.5/§8/§9.

figurative.stands_for: Repeated alignments and connected public routes with legible held-ground boundaries; no claim of a literal hidden designer solving a circuit.
figurative.accept: A route bends around a canal and still visibly belongs to the repeated metal plan.

figurative.stands_for: The authored tidal-lock position and shared geometric sunlight; clouds can still filter exposure and roofs provide shade.
figurative.accept: Cloud reduces direct exposure without turning the native terrain into wet temperate ground or moving the sun through a normal day.

accept: From the landing approach a crew follows aligned passages to an unprotected metal fragment; a patterned divider offers a tempting shorter opening toward visibly held ground.
A canal bends the corridor pattern without severing the public retreat; the player can see why cutting this divider changes access.
Sulfur-coloured edges and an inspect warning distinguish a toxic pool before entry; a worker can choose dry ground around it, while a deliberately exposed entrant suffers the existing terrain hazard.
reject: Random mineable clumps form a circuit-board picture from altitude but leave no deliberate corridors for the crew to follow.
The attractive route terminates inside guardian range with no advance boundary cue or public escape.
A convenient corridor network stands in ordinary green soil under a temperate sky, with no sense that the crew is standing on a poisoned metal country at eternal noon.
Sulfur-coloured pools are harmless decoration, or apparently safe corridor ground harms a worker before the pool boundary can be recognised.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires meaningful routes, marked trespass and recognisable pools that actually harm entrants; patterned clumps, hidden boundaries and theatrical acid water each fail it.

range.varies: Local map sizes 200, 250, 300, 325 cells square; flat authored tile envelope, dry and canal-bearing layouts, all cardinal rotations, map-edge clipping, pre/post ordinary salvage depletion and after a marked breach; one visitor and colony populations 8 and 40; foreground walls and wrecks overlap where the engine allows. M2 enumerates transformed authored local templates, never planet seeds. Use the actual authored temperature/pollution envelope and roofed/unroofed exposure; global geometric Direct Sun and normal weather are active. No local heat multiplier or native soil/greenery substitution. Include dry maps with pools but no coolant canal; shallow/deep toxic water, irradiated patches and sulfuric-looking edge terrain resolved from the ruled provider manifest; dry approach, perimeter, entry, dwell and exit; roofed/unroofed, protected/unprotected entrants, pools beside corridors/held ground/deposit sites; pre/post local-map reload. A dry map means no canal, not permission to omit pools.
range.left_out: No alternative planets, mountainous worlds or layouts authored for foreign biomes. Arbitrary player-built sealed prisons need a blocked-route refusal, not a guarantee of unblocking. Whole-map later colony demolition is assessed as depletion, not native maze regeneration.

sees.instrument: M2 map graph/path sweep plus a live normal-zoom look on the exported best and worst valid layouts; T29/T36 instruments. Visual judgment has no credible offline surrogate. T43 exports pool placement and actual terrain-attributed exposure deltas; a real look decides pre-entry recognition.
sees.start: Fresh authored-tile local map before colony construction; identify start, salvage, public retreat, held footprint and marked divider from the map export, not spawned proof props. Export each pool cell, visual edge and resolved terrain-hazard provider, entrant protection and pre-entry health/exposure baseline; stage no toxin weather or unrelated injury.
sees.on: Every kept mechanic at shipped defaults, all DLC, composed Baroque Biomes and consumer dependencies loaded; no campaign, trait, artificial weather lock or next-version feature required. Negative controls are separate arms, never the acceptance run.
sees.control: Compare graph and live look to same material budget placed as random clumps, and to a marked cut replaced by loose rubble. Guards remain active in the real arm; graph-only success with no visual route distinction is insufficient. Compare matched unprotected entrants on pool versus adjacent dry metal at the same temperature/pollution and duration; record the terrain-attributed health/exposure rise through entry and its cessation on exit. Source-disconnected or cosmetic-only pool mutants must fail, even if ambient pollution harms both arms.
sees.reset: Use an isolated disposable save with a journal of map/global state and settings; save before staging, reload that exact baseline for each arm and on interruption; do not use RM_WornBitProof cleanup on a shared save. Keep failing traces and the midway save.
sees.live_only_why: State and models can expose causal faults but cannot establish visual route legibility and lived warning readability with competing normal game cues.

bars.says: A salvager strips most of the metal in sight freely, including ordinary deck-plate walls, and recovers richer dead smartsteel, while marked route dividers and sacred works are exceptions that warn of their different consequences before damage.

meant.intent: Reject a decorative or scarce salvage paradise or indiscriminate punishment for mining; the bulk of visible, reachable metal is free salvage, with marked shortcuts and sacred works as exceptions.
meant.source: Owner-selected salvage paradise in design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md:21; owner ruling the_forgotten_war.md:228 on freely stripped mineable bulk; frozen sheet §5 sacrilege economics and wall ladder; November shortcut answer qualifies marked dividers, not the free bulk. RM_CathedralDeckPlate.xml defines ordinary plate as mineable RockBase wall, not loose items.

figurative.word: most of the metal in sight
figurative.stands_for: The bulk of visible, reachable ordinary metal is freely mineable wall rock and rubble; marked route dividers and sacred works are recognisable exceptions. Free walls are wall mass whose removal joins no two routes and opens no access into held ground, such as backing, thick wall bulk, outer facades and worked-out spurs; any wall whose removal connects corridors or opens held ground is a marked divider, visible before designation. No area, mass or yield ratio is pinned.
figurative.accept: A crew mines ordinary corridor walls freely across the maze while leaving marked shortcut dividers and protected works intact; neither a distant inaccessible facade nor a depleted worked-out corridor promises a fixed free-metal fraction.

accept: Workers haul mined steel and dead smartsteel from public rubble while the hum stays as it was; selecting a sacred conduit or marked divider shows the risk before the order.
Opening a marked divider yields the same ordinary material but disturbs the place because of what was opened.

A worker mines an unmarked deck-plate corridor wall and hauls its steel without offence; the surrounding ordinary walls are also free salvage, rather than a few loose chunks standing for the whole reward.
reject: Identical unmarked plate sometimes charges an offence only after it has already been mined.
Mineable walls yield unusable decorative objects while the map description calls them treasure.
Only scattered rubble is free; nearly every corridor wall is a marked divider, so salvage means trespass.
Mining an unmarked corridor wall opens a shortcut between routes with no warning or consequence, bypassing the marked cut.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires the bulk of visible, reachable metal, including ordinary deck-plate walls, to be free salvage and marked dividers/sacred works to be exceptions; cosmetic yields, punishment for innocent mining and rubble-only scarcity each fail it.

range.varies: Each material/ownership class: unmarked deck-plate wall and rubble, unmarked dead smartsteel, marked route divider, protected conduit, ordinary player wall and inert wreck; mining, destruction and claim attempts by player, visitor and hostile; yield permitted/zero work outcomes; stack split/haul/merge; reload before first damage and after completion; populations 1..40. Include free wall mass that joins no routes when removed versus walls whose removal connects corridors or opens held ground, before and after surrounding salvage depletion; include an unmarked-wall mutant that opens a costless shortcut bypassing a marked cut, which must fail.
range.left_out: No required exchange rate, yield, market-value ratio, smelting redesign or new stuff alloy. Richer means a salable higher-value material under the current resolved economy, not a pinned price.

meant.intent: Reject a named roster of idle props, fish-only catch tables, land-wandering eels or a giant that secretly retaliates; these are the ruled ordinary residents.

accept: A roach reaches and consumes filth while a bolt traces a ground figure; visible eels circle canal water and a damaged borehulk backs away without selecting an attack.
A dry map has land residents but no invented eel population; an eel stranded by a changed canal remains visible with its condition readable.
reject: Roaches spawn with the right label but never consume reachable dirt, or eels choose water endpoints by paths that cross the dry plate.
The peaceful giant retaliates after damage or is deleted when its path becomes awkward.
bars.lazy: none: The specific resident activities, home-water boundary and peaceful giant exclude merely spawning named pawns.

range.varies: Each kept RM resident in its native spawned state; campaign mynock and voltmaw in the patched roster without eviction; absent/present giant, no-water, connected water, disconnected pools, narrow channels, filled cell, blocked route, daytime native temperature/pollution envelope, resident death and save/load; roach food absent/present/out of range; population 0,1,8,40 colonists; inherited flight checks for actual flyers. Distinguish coolant canals from toxic/sulfuric pools; test resident paths and exposure beside both, with inherited native-water drinking intact.
range.left_out: No new taming, custom predator web, repair/ownership/mining arc or generated organic wildlife. Forced spawning a giant on every map is not required. Campaign canon names do not leak into RM defs.

bars.says: A player working the plateau can hear and see the hum and living bolts change with disturbance, locate any active offending work and stop it before its next avoidable escalation, or identify an unpaid bill and its originating Cathedral tile when no offending work is active, without learning a secret or a skill.

meant.intent: Reject truthful hidden numbers with no useful warning, location cues pointing at innocent work, or progression-gated observation; the owner explicitly chose bolts gathering around what they dislike.
meant.source: Frozen sheet §5 and §P; owner warning answer 2026-11-10; standing readable-sign rule; delegated baseline work-site fallback from absence/unreachability of bolts.

figurative.stands_for: The sustained layered environmental sound and its cessation, not a voice saying its cause.
figurative.accept: At the worst mood the sustained sound falls silent while visual warning remains.

accept: With fishing and innocent hauling running together, the sound changes and bolts gather by the fisher; the work-site indication lets the player cancel the line before another catch.
When bolts cannot reach the active cut, its baseline work-site cue still identifies the order; its protected status was visible before damage.

With no active offending work on either the origin map or a neighbouring Cathedral tile, bolts retain non-calm stiffness without gathering at any work; the hum inspector names the unpaid damage bill and its originating Cathedral tile.
reject: The hidden band rises but stage-capped sound stays calm, or a newcomer needs a hum-reader book to find the cause.
The sound changes only as the response strikes, and moving bolts are clustered around a ship rather than the active work.
bars.lazy: none: Active work requires actionable location and timing before avoidable escalation; floor-only unease requires the unpaid bill and originating tile, excluding nominal band changes and invented targets at innocent jobs.

range.varies: Calm through worst and recovery transitions; fishing, divider breach, bolt kill, sacred damage and deep working drill; one and multiple simultaneous causes on separate sides of a map; 0,1 and crowded local bolt groups; obstructed paths, no reader/droid/ship, sound muted with visual warning on, map switch paused/unpaused, viewed/unviewed state, reload during active job; colonies 1,8,40. Threat already in melee is a separate combat state. Floor-only arm: unpaid sacred receipt with no active cause, on both its origin map and a neighbouring Cathedral map, with ordinary innocent hauling present and after reload; the hum inspect line identifies the unpaid bill and originating tile while bolts gather at no work.
range.left_out: No mind identity, explanation of droid mercy, hidden coolant meaning or deep-response explanation. No prevention of the atomic first intentional hit; protected status must precede that order. No guarantee that a player ignoring both channels notices.

accept: Guards threaten a crew inside their visible ground and remain there after it withdraws; a deep response converges on the working drill and leaves once its target is removed.
A fisher who stopped causing irritation is not selected across the map by the drill response; distant ordinary drilling retains ordinary game risk.
reject: A force receives an assault-colony order and chases a retreating fisher past the held boundary.
Removing the drill leaves the response wandering forever or changes its target to the nearest bedroom.

bars.says: A returning crew finds minor disturbance eased by time and restraint, while stripping or claiming sacred works leaves an uneasy warning that reachable material repayment clears and a real Enclave goodwill loss that can close contact.

meant.intent: Reject either blanket waiting-away of desecration or a permanent unrecoverable punishment; this is the explicit return ruling, necessary for repeat salvage visits. A local number alone is insufficient: unpaid damage must remain noticeable below diplomatic hostility, and the ruled isolation is actual Enclave contact loss.
meant.source: Owner return answer 2026-11-10 in ANSWERS_OWNER.md; frozen sacrilege economics; delegated material delivery contract in definition.md from costly concrete repayment without a ritual. Enclave currency/isolation: owner ruling 2026-08-19, the_forgotten_war.md:229-244; delegated unpaid-sacred hum floor, without extra guard aggression.

figurative.stands_for: The existing hum/bolt display stays at least at its first non-calm warning while any sacred receipt remains unpaid; it does not assert a crew mood debuff.
figurative.accept: After an unpaid offence, the hum is less settled than its paid baseline even though public corridors remain open and no guard approaches.

accept: Fishing first raises the hum with an attributed warning; cancellation and quiet restore its calm baseline while continued fishing keeps the warning raised.

Sacred destruction or claim leaves an uneasy hum even while Enclave contact is still open; paying that offence removes its warning floor, and a neighbouring Cathedral visit carries the same unpaid receipts.

Desecration that has made the Enclaves hostile removes their contact without summoning an army; quiet leaves it lost, and material repayments that settle the outstanding sacrilege restore contact when the relationship recovers.
Workers finish the named silver delivery from the public side and the corresponding receipt and warning restriction clear; an interrupted delivery resumes without paying twice.
Player fire chips a sacred conduit but leaves it standing and unclaimed: fast irritation and its warning rise, Enclave goodwill stays unchanged and no unpaid sacred receipt is committed.
reject: Idling clears sacred debt, or the repayment order exists only inside the hostile perimeter it is supposed to reopen.
Payment changes only local standing while the Enclave relationship and its lost contact remain untouched, or repeated claim cycling farms credit.
An unpaid sacred offence below diplomatic hostility has no persistent readable consequence, or landing on another Cathedral map forgets it.
An inherited uneasy hum sends bolts toward innocent haulers.
bars.lazy: none: Attributed minor recovery, a persistent unpaid warning and real Enclave contact loss/restoration exclude an always-calm fishing input, a cosmetic debt counter and a map-local diplomatic substitute.

range.varies: Minor arm: no sacred/deep debt and calm recorded start, fishing must first cause a recorded rise above calm and a cue. Sacred arm: single sub-latch debt with persistent non-calm hum floor removed by payment; several unpaid debts below hostility with the same floor and accumulated composite pressure; Enclave hostile latch before/at/after -75, recovery below/at/above 0 with range -100..100. Vary unrelated goodwill gains/losses and pre-existing hostility; no promise to erase those losses. Sacred work damaged but standing and unclaimed: fast irritation and warning only, no Enclave goodwill change or unpaid sacred receipt; then destruction (including stripping) or claim commits the once-only debit. Replacement and repeat damage; no/multiple debts; partial/full payment, insufficient funds, carrier death, cancellation, unreachable deposit, map departure, neighbouring Cathedral arrival, old local map unloaded/deleted, reload at each transaction boundary; minor fishing and shortcut work before/after payment. Guards defend the same footprint in every relation state; the diplomatic latch changes Enclave contact, never their pursuit boundary. Ordinary goodwill gifts can restore diplomatic contact before a material receipt is settled; its unpaid warning floor remains until material payment.
range.left_out: No forgiveness of campaign deliberate betrayal, no god rewards or new rite, no positive credit from waiting. The exact replacement-value multiplier is an attackable rule, not a bar. Permanent destruction of public access by player construction can give a clear no-consumption refusal. A debt’s payment cannot free existing prisoners, resurrect cancelled trade requests or recreate departed ships; restoration means future contact is eligible again. No new Enclave raids or campaign progression are required.

sees.instrument: M1 transaction/relation state walks and M3 recovery curves; calibrate real faction goodwill/relation-kind callbacks, available Enclave contact, hum baseline, inventories and global receipt identities across saves and neighbouring maps (T30/T31/T36).

Sacred arms record actual pre-offence Enclave goodwill/relation-kind, available trade/contact, all global and local receipts, hum floor, bill values, silver inventory and public deposit location; no precredited proof delivery. Include Enclave guests, an active trade request and a passing ship in a disposable hostility-flip fixture.
sees.on: Every kept mechanic at shipped defaults, all DLC, composed Baroque Biomes and consumer dependencies loaded; no campaign, trait, artificial weather lock or next-version feature required. Negative controls are separate arms, never the acceptance run. The fixed-world Enclave faction is resolved through its existing Utinni integration, independent of deferred mission/Regard progression; absence is missing evidence for the diplomatic arm, never a local-ledger substitute.
sees.control: Minor arm must first read the fishing-attributed rise above calm and its cue: calm without that prior rise is invalid. Branch from the raised state into cancellation/quiet and continued-fishing arms; continued fishing must stay raised over the same interval. Separately compare quiet-only and paid sacred arms from the same debt/relation state, an unrelated delivery and a duplicate completion callback. Read consumed silver, receipt settlement, hum-floor removal and actual Enclave contact eligibility, not a message or local standing alone. Test an isolated sub-latch offence and a real hostility flip; exclude storyteller raids, ordinary heat and independent goodwill changes as causes. Travel to another Cathedral tile and reload without forgiving or replaying debits. Compare sacred work damaged but standing and unclaimed with its later destruction/claim: only the latter commits the receipt and Enclave debit; duplicate destruction after claim cannot debit again.

bars.says: Across a full-map season with the complete shipped biome active, a colony can repeat the route, salvage, disturbance, withdrawal and repayment cycle after a midway reload and changed action order without losing readable choices to a flood, a barren map, a stall or an error storm.

meant.intent: Reject a system that only works in isolated demonstrations: land, life and temper must remain playable together over their own cycle.
meant.source: Whole-bar requirement in this cleanse brief; owner-selected salvage/temper experience; delegated failure regimes and repeated-visit story from all kept mechanics.

figurative.stands_for: Unbounded native events, objects or combat pressure that consumes the ordinary salvage decisions.
figurative.accept: A crowded work site is acceptable if its events end and the player can still choose and cancel work.

figurative.stands_for: Native activity destroys access to the promised land/life/salvage before ordinary use; finite deposits legitimately mined out are depletion, not failure.
figurative.accept: A worked quarry is empty while untouched public salvage remains reachable.

figurative.stands_for: A loop cannot progress or settle despite valid player actions, such as a response waiting forever for a removed drill.
figurative.accept: A worker pauses for an honestly missing material and resumes after it is delivered.

figurative.stands_for: Repeating mod-attributable exceptions or warnings that obscure play or keep a mechanic retrying.
figurative.accept: An ordinary loss produces a readable in-game consequence without a repeating log fault.

accept: Careful trips route around damaging visible pools and still recover finite salvage while reckless work provokes local warnings and bounded defence; quiet eases minor work, and paid sacred debts remove their warning floor and permit Enclave contact to recover after the saved season resumes.

Fishers disturb the place before miners breach a divider in a rerun, and both causes remain understandable; the worn giant and cleaners stay ordinary residents with the repair and hull stories dormant.
reject: Every isolated demonstration works, but concurrent fishing and a breach trap the colony in permanent hostility after it has stopped and paid its actual debts.
The map fills with curiosity drops or repeated force spawns, every open route becomes unusable, residents silently disappear, work stalls, or the log repeats errors.
bars.lazy: none: The complete default season, reload and changed order plus named failure regimes exclude isolated showcases and a calm locked map.

range.varies: Full local maps 200..325 square from the B1 dry/canal envelope; 15 in-game days including day/night-equivalent fixed-sun weather variation supplied by the authored tile, plus recovery tail to day 30 where a debt/force remains; colonies 1,8,40; ordinary/restraint, repeated minor disturbance, deliberate sacred/deep intrusion workloads. Save at mid-season with active jobs/debt; rerun same action multiset in fishing-then-cut and cut-then-fishing order. Day-100 continuation is a depletion/state-continuity stress check, not a requirement that finite deposits refill. Include a sub-latch sacred offence, an Enclave hostility flip/restoration and travel to a second Cathedral local map; stationary toxic pools remain active through seasonal exposure and resident pathing.
range.left_out: No extras on, foreign biomes, alternative worlds, climate seed sweep or forced clear sky. Player-driven total demolition/extermination and unrelated catastrophic storyteller endings are not native equilibrium failures; the trace must distinguish them from mod-caused failures.

sees.instrument: M3 whole-mod model first, then real full-map season replay and live land/warning observations. Compression may batch idle tick intervals only while preserving every transition, actor job ordering, event eligibility/cooldown, random stream, weather progression, heat exposure, depletion, pawn scheduling and save serialization; otherwise run actual ticks. T36 is required; current isolated proof hooks cannot decide this.
sees.start: Fresh native map and complete settings/def fingerprints, no hidden campaign locks; record residents, salvage sources, standing, water, public paths, threat RNG and log baseline. Stage real colony actions through jobs, not direct debit setters. Include pool cells/hazard-provider fingerprints, Enclave goodwill/relation-kind/contact and global sacred receipts.
sees.on: Every kept mechanic at shipped defaults, all DLC, composed Baroque Biomes and consumer dependencies loaded; no campaign, trait, artificial weather lock or next-version feature required. Negative controls are separate arms, never the acceptance run. Existing fixed-world Enclave integration is active with optional campaign progression still off.
sees.control: Match each event to actor, source, target and cue; compare restrained baseline, offence workload and delayed-source controls at identical weather/RNG inputs. Snapshot the save then replay in reverse action order from a clean baseline; a calm scene due to an unwired mechanic is invalid, not a pass. A paid local ledger with unchanged Enclave consequences fails; compare hazard-pool entry to matched dry-ground exposure and track source-attributed damage.
sees.reset: Use an isolated disposable save with a journal of map/global state and settings; save before staging, reload that exact baseline for each arm and on interruption; do not use RM_WornBitProof cleanup on a shared save. Keep failing traces and the midway save.
sees.live_only_why: State and models can expose causal faults but cannot establish visual route legibility and lived warning readability with competing normal game cues.

qualification.reject_test: Reject a system that only works in isolated demonstrations: land, life and temper must remain playable together over their own cycle.
qualification.renormalize: No acceptance picture fixes a yield, stat, speed, size, value or variant count. Retuning preserves this qualitative promise; new art does not itself demand a re-pass.

checks.what: Inherited floor: loads, clean log, effective Mod Settings, honest scope text and all-off controls. A red reading is attributed to mod/site/instrument before repair; it is not a refusal independent of a bar.

Parse current merged BiomeDef XML as elements: native wildPlants empty, forageability zero, animalDensity positive, catch and rock defs resolve; campaign roster patch has actual resolved additions. No evictions/tier leaks.

Owner economics: actual Free Droid Enclave goodwill starts neutral 0 in the fixed-world fixture, sacred debit 15 once per structure on destruction (including stripping) or claim; damage while standing and unclaimed changes only fast irritation/warning, with no Enclave debit or unpaid receipt. Vanilla relation hostile at -75 and recovery at 0. Keep global receipts and local hum mirror distinct; first unpaid sacred receipt imposes at least first non-calm warning independent of composite thresholds. Permanent-enemy Arsenal goodwill is unchanged. Guard footprint/targets do not expand at the diplomatic latch.

Record current attitude thresholds 10/30/55/80, hysteresis 6, base half-life 1 day, interval 250 ticks as source-snapshot regressions from RM_RustCathedralAttitude.xml; these are not passing numbers and may be retuned.
No planet rarity capability/scoring can create or place a world; required worker identity may remain inert. Zero world tiles is expected, never a finding.

Switch-off state manifest: fresh defaults, all next-version emissions absent; definitions/code retained; enabled controls prove each gate reaches its own emitter. Existing explicit prefs upgrade visibly, no silent state deletion.

Saved event/job/object identities survive duplicate callbacks, haul split/merge, interrupted work, pawn death, map removal and reload without double debit/credit or hidden despawn. Global sacred receipt/deposit identities and actual Enclave relationship persist across adjacent Cathedral maps, unloaded/deleted local maps and map regeneration; no reset to a clean sacred standing.
Validate actual eel path cells, cleaner source consumption, peaceful giant jobs and runtime flight tracker; not just destination cells, def labels or spawned counts.
Record target resource, usable-drill conditions, lord targets/exit and cooldowns; nonqualifying drill and toggle-off arms retain vanilla eligibility.
Measure current scribed/default/reset feature values for each gate; source defaults formerly on do not become an approved first-version feature by accident.

Run existing relevant source/def selftests as regressions after consumer changes, adapting obsolete assertions only with attributed evidence; old validation.py north-star entries are not a substitute tree. No missing-instrument zero.

Repayment bill uses positive resolved replacement value, multiplier 2 as delegated tuning; compare delivered/consumed/refunded silver and saved debit receipts exactly; no arbitrary zero bill. Sacred credit changes real Enclave goodwill by no more than the original effective debit with no repayment-created positive relation credit; read actual contact eligibility at recovery, not just a ledger or success text.

Surface string corpus: cathedral_arc_lint.py plus actual displayed settings/letters/inspect/scanner text; planted secret control must fail. Static source lints alone do not prove text not assembled at runtime.

Resolve the August hazard manifest against current terrain providers before build: ToxicWaterShallow/Deep (historical factor 3), VEE_IrradiatedWater* (8), VEE_SulfuricWater* (1) are ruling references, not verified current defs. Export actual resolved terrain IDs/hazard factors and pool cells; source-attributed pool exposure must differ from matched dry metal. No AB_Tar/AB_PropaneLake/AB_LiquidSlime substitute, missing provider treated as missing evidence, never harmless water passed as a hazard.

rules.rule: Use a local corridor/held-footprint graph with loose rubble and inspectably marked structural dividers; labels persist by source identity after breach. Do not add a planet generator. Corridor layout is a rule open to replacement, intentional legible routes are the bar.

Persist local act/source ids per map and sacred offence/payment transaction ids in a game-level ledger keyed by persistent originating-map and original-structure identities. Removing or unloading a map cannot erase sacred receipts. Deduplicate scan, damage, catch/butcher, faction-signal and reload callbacks; attribute actual player acts, never haul location or nonplayer crossfire.

Minor fishing, shortcut and bolt-kill inputs affect fast irritation only; passive standing ratchet and catch-standing costs are off. Sacred destruction (including stripping) or claim debits the real Free Droid Enclave relationship once per structure; damage short of destruction or claim raises only fast irritation and warning, without a faction debit or unpaid sacred receipt. These game-level unpaid receipts persist across all Cathedral maps. Each local hum mirrors those receipts, with a floor at the first non-calm band while any remains unpaid; debt pressure can raise the band further. Vanilla Enclave FactionRelation hostility/recovery controls isolation, never Arsenal guard pursuit. Local saved standing remains for deep intrusion, separate from global sacred goodwill; permanent-enemy Arsenal relations are never the sacrilege currency. For the hum only, derive standing by subtracting unpaid sacred receipt debits from the saved local deep-standing value and clamping to its existing bounds; never write that mirror back as a faction debit. Feed the existing composite/band hysteresis, then impose the unpaid-sacred display floor. Partial material deposits leave the receipt outstanding until completion. Independent vanilla gifts can restore Enclave contact without clearing the material receipt or this floor. When unpaid receipts are the only cause, bolts retain non-calm stiffness without gathering at any work, and the public hum inspect line identifies each unpaid damage bill and its originating Cathedral world tile, on both origin and neighbouring maps, without revealing hidden lore.

Cathedral-owned guards use marked footprint/patrol targeting; custom drill force uses actual qualifying drill identity and exits on invalidation. Nonqualifying drills keep vanilla infestation eligibility and foreign mech factions keep their rules. Enclave hostility does not enlarge guard footprints or retarget them; its consequence is diplomatic isolation through the existing faction relation handlers, without scheduling a raid.

Repay damage is a public-side ordinary delivery order, silver bill twice intact replacement market value with positive def fallback. A game-level sacred receipt and Enclave debit commit on destruction (including stripping) or claim, never damage while standing and unclaimed, and only once across maps/reload; settlement credits at most its actual original Enclave debit with no repayment-created positive goodwill, removes only that receipt and recalculates every map’s unpaid-sacred warning floor. Partial deposits and destroyed-site markers survive map removal; revisit rematerialises the same site identity. Other unpaid debts or unrelated diplomatic losses can keep contact closed; payment does not recreate lost ships/requests or release prisoners. Deep episodes use the same transaction mechanism but credit only their recorded local standing debit, never Enclave goodwill. No consumed-deposit refund, local/global double credit or positive-standing farming.

Public hum and bolt cues use actual local mood without campaign stage ceiling; unfinished campaign progression is dormant. Active reachable causes attract bolts with rotating selection; baseline inspect/click-through work-site cue covers absent bolts or obstacles. Do not require a reader trait. When unpaid receipts are the only cause, bolts retain non-calm stiffness without gathering at any work, and the public hum inspect line identifies each unpaid damage bill and its originating Cathedral world tile, on both origin and neighbouring maps, without revealing hidden lore.

A true mechanics master and per-major-feature gates stop pending effects as well as new work; defaults/reset/Scribe agree, deferred extras off and labelled Next version, migration explicit and non-destructive, existing unsupported cross-biome options off. Per-feature off retains dormant saved debt and living pawns. Sacred consequence off stops new sacred debits and suspends the hum floor; retained faction goodwill/relation-kind and completed vanilla diplomatic effects are not rewritten or undone. Re-enable reconciles the same global receipts without replaying debits.

Keep the resolved resident roster without evictions; roaches clean independently of mood, eel destinations and actual paths stay in water and stranded eels remain visible; worn borehulk never attacks or mines. Shared engines retain their contracts. Hazard pools are not a substitute for coolant canals; use the existing native-water and terrain-hazard contracts rather than inventing eel immunity or disabling pool damage for the whole run.

Use only observable surface register for descriptions/settings/scanner/letters; preserve all frozen secrecy bans, including no explanation of droid mercy and no description of the deep response beyond massive mechanoid movement.

Ambient temperature/pollution come from the fixed tile and sun exposure from the one shared geometric rule; legacy overhead field is not a heat multiplier. Rust dust and shimmer are visual atmosphere. Stationary pools are real land hazards: use the owner-ruled toxic terrain and irradiated patches with sulfuric-looking edges, resolving the current provider defs before implementation. No new acid-damage mechanic, spreading hazard or acid weather. Place pools visibly apart from safe corridors and deposit approaches; label their hazard before entry and preserve their cells across reload. Cosmetic edge cells must not falsely imply that toxic inner water is safe.

Finite vanilla mining, inert wreck salvage and catch-table fishing supply ordinary outputs; no automatic metal regrowth, curiosity production or new salvage industry. Eel pawns are not a counterfeit count of Odyssey fish pool stock.

Season replay may compress idle intervals only if transition order, actor jobs, rates, RNG, weather, temperature, depletion and serialization are equivalent to real ticks; no fixed-clear test sky or disabled kept subsystem.

meetings.why: Marked cuts, public escape, canal paths, giant clearance, guard footprints, repayment placement and post-mining topology meet here. Pairwise reachability cannot prove all remain reachable together. Stationary toxic pools must leave a safe public route and repayment approach while remaining recognisable before entry; do not confuse them with viable coolant channels.
meetings.model: M2: Local geometry and boundary sweep

meetings.why: The same material can be loose or structural: map labels determine trespass, material defs determine yield. A breached divider retains identity for once-only offence, while already paid silver never becomes native salvage. Finite depletion is explicitly allowed. The economic rate risk belongs to the attitude meeting.

Ordinary held-ground guards and drill forces remain spatially bounded at all Enclave relation states. The Enclave hostility latch changes contact, not targets. Real relation-change callbacks, ongoing combat, drill loss and reload still need joint state walks to exclude a chase/stall or unintended army.

Multiple simultaneous sources compete for bolts and colony attention; sound, work-site indication and cancellation may be individually correct but too late together. Model timing cannot certify audible/visual salience. The debt floor must differ from paid calm even below hostility, and toxic-pool edges must read before entry rather than relying on the hum to announce exposure.
meetings.model: M3: Whole-mod season and workload model

meetings.why: One reload can replay scan charges, restart a response or forgive a debt while every isolated subsystem test passes. Saved transactions, creature identities, weather and action-order swaps need whole-run traces. Sacred receipts, partial deposits and real Enclave goodwill must survive travel, unloading and loss of the originating map; local hum mirrors must neither forget nor duplicate them.
meetings.model: M3: Whole-mod season and workload model

meetings.why: Fishing workload, shortcut input, warning delay, decay, sacred/deep debt and repayment meet in the complete loop. Removing the passive drain prevents one obvious ratchet but does not establish a useful quiet-work window at colony scale. A single global sacred receipt must keep the local display non-calm across maps even when the scalar composite alone would be calm; payment removes that floor without clearing other pressure.
meetings.model: M3: Whole-mod season and workload model

meetings.why: Water confinement, sun/pollution survival, cleaning availability, combat and finite eel/giant presence can erase native life when combined even if each def works alone. No unsupported perfect population equilibrium is assumed. Toxic-pool exposure and coolant-path selection now join the native water/survival range; harmless decorative pools cannot be the survival solution.
meetings.model: M3: Whole-mod season and workload model

meetings.why: Each off switch suspends the corresponding effects and pending escalation while preserving defs/pawns/dormant debt. Sound mute leaves visual warning. The complete shipped run excludes off arms; negative arms are separate controlled readings, so disabling cannot fake a pass. Off suspends future custom sacred consequences and the warning floor, but does not reset actual Enclave diplomacy or undo vanilla prisoners/trade cancellation. Pool-placement controls are labelled new local maps only; existing pool terrain remains ordinary terrain.

Warnings describe observable target, damage and sound, and repayment describes an ordinary bill. None requires identity, droid-mercy explanation or deep cause. Scanner and all actual runtime text use the same surface register; the empty campaign stage does not suppress the public local mood.

Global sacred receipts conserve actual faction debits separately from local deep standing: a once-only payment cannot credit both currencies, forgive another map’s unpaid offence or generate positive goodwill. The unpaid warning floor clears only with the final unpaid sacred receipt; real Enclave contact also requires vanilla nonhostile recovery, so unrelated losses may still matter. Public-side access remains the layout unknown and cross-map atomicity the continuity unknown; this is a logical contract, not a measurement.
